subject: Retailify POC — compact outcomes & quick publish call
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@retailify.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@retailify.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Retailify POC — compact outcomes & quick publish call

Hi Dana / Alex,

Thanks again for the time last week — really enjoyed working with your infra and ops teams. I promised a short recap of the key outcomes we saw during the two-week POC and a quick ask about a short quote/call to capture a one-line blurb for a follow-up case note.

Quick outcomes (end-to-end Retailify workload):
- Avg inference latency: 220ms -> 92ms (58% reduction) at 512-token median requests
- Cost per 1k generated tokens: down ~37% vs. your current hosted endpoint (projected savings at scale)
- 99.95% availability during peak test windows; sustained throughput increase of 2.1x with same infra footprint
- Successful KV prefix cache reduced repeated prompt token usage by ~28% for common product-description flows

Attached: retailify_poc_dashboard.pdf (summary dashboard + sample traces).

Request: would Retailify be comfortable with a short (one-sentence) quote we can use in a compact case snippet and permission to display your logo? We can draft wording for you to edit — would prefer something as small as a single line, e.g. "Redwood cut our inference costs and halved latency in production-like workloads." If you’re open, can we schedule a 20-minute call to finalize a one-liner and ask a couple quick ops questions?

Proposed slots: Wed 12/3 10:00–10:20 PT or Thu 12/4 13:00–13:20 PT. If those don’t work we can send a Calendly link.

If it’s easier I’ve drafted a suggested blurb (attached) — feel free to edit directly.

Thanks,
Sojin
Sojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
